name: woslicer-dx
description: Offline desktop BMS wav slicer reimplementing woslicerIII, byte-compatible with the original .wos format and slicer DSP

scripts.typecheck: npm run gen:i18n && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:tooling && npm run test:components && npm run gen:i18n && node -e "fs.rmSync('dist/tests',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.tests.json && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js
scripts.fmt: oxfmt --write src tests scripts vite.config.mts playwright.app.config.mts eslint.config.mjs .oxfmtrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.lint.json .github/workflows .github/actions
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check src tests scripts vite.config.mts playwright.app.config.mts eslint.config.mjs .oxfmtrc.json package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.lint.json .github/workflows .github/actions
scripts.check:quality: npm run lint && npm run fmt:check && npm run typecheck
